title: BugDNA Drift
description: Serialized representation of a BugDNA failure fingerprint drift detection result

id.description: Deterministic identifier of the fingerprint evaluated for drift (prefixed with BUGDNA- followed by 16 uppercase hexadecimal characters)

signatureDriftPercentage.description: Degree of signature and call path drift expressed as an integer percentage from 0 to 100

isPossibleCodePathChange.description: Indicates whether the signature drift percentage meets or exceeds the threshold (>= 50%) suggesting a possible code path change
